{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Support for making the tax relief of 2001 and 2003 permanent.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The various expiring tax relief provisions, ranging from 2005 to 2011, make the tax code confusing for everybody and limits the ability of workers, families, and businesses to plan for the future with confidence.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The death tax is reduced now, disappears in 2010, and then comes fully back to life in 2011.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for efforts to develop a tax code that does not punish taxpayers for saving.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for replacing the tax code with a system that is simpler, provides more freedom to citizens, is pro-growth, boosts the economy, and encourages savings and investment.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A tax code that provides several definitions of a child needs to be reformed.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for legislation requiring a super-majority vote in both houses of Congress to raise taxes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Prohibition of retroactive taxation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to attempts by federal judges to impose taxes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to all attempts by the United Nations to impose a global tax.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Rejection of any claims of authority by the United Nations to impose a global tax.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Religious and fraternal benevolent societies should not be subject to taxation because of their vital role in fostering charity and patriotism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
